desc: The Speed Stand is the most portable and convenient gun cleaning stand on the market. Use at home or at the range for quick modifications and cleaning of all your rifles and shotguns. The adjustable feet allow for use on uneven surfaces while the Gun Gripper yokes firmly secure your firearm. Speed Stand collapses down to a 10″ footprint for easy storage or transportation while extending up to 16″ to allow for the perfect fit for your rifles and shotguns.
